name: scatterly
description: Scatterly (Where'd I Put It?) - a cosy deduction puzzle game

scripts.e2e:smoke: playwright test -g "boots to Menu|an uncaught error"
scripts.verify: node scripts/secret-scan.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vitest run && npm run build && node scripts/check-assets.mjs && python3 tools/check-frames/check_fronts.py && playwright test -g "boots to Menu|an uncaught error"
scripts.shots: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.shots.config.ts
